title: One altcoin-kimchi sleeve over all 44 Upbit-listed coins (16 + 28), replacing v8.1's 16-coin sleeve at the same total size

rule: Gen247 A rule unchanged per coin (z > 1 long, z < -1 short, next day) on the 16 original and 28 extra coins; per-coin size 0.1 x 16 / 44 so the sleeve's total size matches v8's; costs 5 bp per side on the 16 (perps + funding), 10 bp on the 28 extras (less liquid; their funding files are incomplete, so no funding)
